m: यर्हि ind. (fr. 3. य; correlative of तर्हि, एतर्हि, but also followed by तदा, तत्र, अथ &c.) when, at which time, whenever, while, whereas (with pres. or Pot., imp. aor. or pf.; sometimes also with no verb), TS.; AitBr.; BhP.
a: यर्हि — ind. [यद्-र्हिल्, cf. P. V. 3. 21] 1 When, while, whenever. --2 Because, as, since; (its proper correlative is तर्हि or एतर्हि, but it is seldom used in classical literature).
